about: Breadcrumbs: one-line lessons pinned to files. Shown to Claude whenever it reads or edits the path. Managed by the breadcrumbs mod; commit this file.

crumbs.note: JSX compiles against the global h: never name a variable h (or Fragment) where JSX is in scope. A .map(h => ...) here once broke the whole pane silently.

Mod engine rules: a module may hook an event WITHOUT a matcher only once; $ may cross files only into a `function` declaration, not an arrow; a tool.call `context` must be a list of strings. Run `claude plugin test` before every push.
The Claude mobile app shows NO mod panes (verified on Josh's iPhone). Anything Josh must see goes through a command's { text } reply or a chat answer.
Every dialog line is read by Josh deciding fast: plain words, say it is REAL (not a test), what happens, whether it can be undone, Block first. Jargon here once got a yes he didn't understand.
Cloud sessions start from the repo's DEFAULT branch, so a mod here reaches new sessions only once it is merged there.
